test_style_set_properties: test the Styler.set_properties method to apply CSS properties like color and size to DataFrame cells
test_style_hide: test the Styler.hide method to hide index or column headers and names in MultiIndex DataFrames
test_style_apply: test the Styler.apply method to apply custom styling functions across DataFrame rows, columns, or the entire table
test_style_export: test the Styler.export and use methods to capture and reuse styling configurations across multiple DataFrames
test_style_render_trimming: test the Styler rendering trimming behavior with max_elements, max_rows, and max_columns options
